population.kidComparison: About 37.1 million people live in Uzbekistan—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Temperate four-season climate with warm summers and cool to cold winters.
geography.terrain: Inland terrain bordered by neighboring countries.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Uzbekistan
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Uzbekistan.

exploration.didYouKnow: Uzbekistan is located in Central Asia and its capital city is Tashkent.
